definitions.explanation: A category or style of something.
A container used to give shape to something.
A set form or sequence of movements in martial arts.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{型|かた}のスマホが{出|で}た。
examples.english: A new model of smartphone came out.

examples.japanese: ケーキの{型|かた}を{買|か}った。

notes:
{型|かた} means type, model, or mold.

COMMON USES:
- {血液型|けつえきがた}: blood type
- {新型|しんがた}: new model
- {旧型|きゅうがた}: old model
- {型紙|かたがみ}: pattern (sewing)

MARTIAL ARTS:
{型|かた} is a set sequence of movements practiced for training.
